note: Closed registry of reference aliases. An alias reads like the place it names: @workspaces/fe and @workspaces/be are the bound project's routed checkouts, @knowledge/ui and @worktrees/businesses mirror the folders, @npm is the registry, @external/{remote,ghcr,github-actions,minio} are services, @grammar is the @starci/grammar package as the app resolves it. `<Source>` is the host repository that owns this .claude. A sub-path after a registered alias narrows it; a segment in angle brackets is supplied by the invocation. Resolution picks the longest registered prefix.

@workspaces/fe.bind: fingerprint + sourceHead (git rev-parse HEAD of the checkout)
@workspaces/fe.purpose: The routed frontend checkout of the bound project.

@workspaces/be.bind: fingerprint + sourceHead (git rev-parse HEAD of the checkout)
@workspaces/be.purpose: The routed backend checkout of the bound project.

@workspaces.resolvesTo: <checkout:project/role>  (any routed checkout named explicitly, for cross-project reads: @workspaces/nivo/fe)
@workspaces.bind: fingerprint + sourceHead (git rev-parse HEAD of the checkout)
@workspaces.purpose: A checkout of another project. The bound project's own are @workspaces/fe and @workspaces/be.

@workspaces/projects.purpose: Portable route declarations, tracked. The only place a route is declared.

@workspaces/local/routes.purpose: Machine-local hydrated routes; project the declarations onto this disk. Ignored by Git.

@workspaces/ports.purpose: Port projection: project offset and application slots. Endpoints are derived, never typed.

@workspaces/device-state.resolvesTo: <Source>/.workspaces/device-state.json  (sealed keys live in <Source>/.workspaces/local/credentials/*.key.enc and are bound by name, never read)
@workspaces/device-state.purpose: Machine identity and the encrypted credential roster reference.

@npm.resolvesTo: the npm registry entry for <package>, e.g. @npm/@starci/grammar@0.3.0
@npm.purpose: Published packages. A version is the binding; latest is never a binding.

@grammar.resolvesTo: the @starci/grammar package as the bound app resolves it: `file:packages/grammar` inside @workspaces/fe today (source 0.4.0), or @npm/@starci/grammar@<version> (0.3.0 published); the receipt records which
@grammar.bind: package.json version + the resolved location's fingerprint (checkout head for file:, tarball integrity for npm)
@grammar.purpose: The Grammar as it runs: renderers, props, owned relationships, data-contract claims, core/styles.css. The only fact about what a component owns.

@knowledge/ui.bind: fingerprint per file; rule inventory = every `## PREFIX-n` heading in the folder
@knowledge/ui.purpose: Universal UI law: what a tree must contain, which value an app boundary takes, what is only true once rendered.

@knowledge/grammars.bind: fingerprint per file; rule inventory = every `## PREFIX-n` heading in the folder
@knowledge/grammars.purpose: Law about a family: how it realizes Common. Never the Grammar itself; where it disagrees with @grammar, @grammar is the fact and this is the finding.

@knowledge/patterns.bind: fingerprint per file; rule inventory = every `## PREFIX-n` heading in the folder
@knowledge/patterns.purpose: Code conventions counted from the two live sources; a rule cites two real paths.

@worktrees/businesses.resolvesTo: <Source>/.worktrees/businesses/  (features/<featureId>/model.json; business-registry-v1.json is the head index; objects/sha256/ the content store)
@worktrees/businesses.bind: content address from business-registry-v1.json featureHeads.<featureId>.head, with authorityStatus
@worktrees/businesses.purpose: Business promise heads. Its own git worktree; a head binds by content address even before its commit lands.

@worktrees/sessions.resolvesTo: <Source>/.worktrees/sessions/<sessionId>/  (leases, inventories, blockers, and each invocation's artifacts/)

@worktrees/sessions/central-runtime.purpose: The shared runtime owner: generation, status, endpoints, health evidence. Callers consume, never own.

@worktrees/uat.purpose: Canonical UAT pair per flow and case. Never carries a credential.

@worktrees/debts.purpose: Owner-approved quality debts. A debt without a live approval here is not a debt.

@worktrees/_templates.purpose: Authority templates for new heads, debts, sessions, and UAT pairs. Consumed, never modified.

@artifacts.bind: fingerprint per artifact; every artifact written is registered in output.artifactRefs
@artifacts.purpose: The only place an operator writes: its receipt and named artifacts, including audit captures.

@receipt.resolvesTo: <@artifacts of invocation <invocationId>>/<receiptType>.json  (the receipt file that invocation registered in output.artifactRefs)
@receipt.bind: fingerprint + the sourceHead the receipt binds
@receipt.purpose: A predecessor's typed receipt, read whole and unchanged.

@external/remote.bind: observed remote head (git ls-remote) at invocation time
@external/remote.purpose: The publication target; fast-forwardness is decided against this observation.

@external/ghcr.purpose: Immutable release images. A tag is never a binding; a digest is.

@external/github-actions.resolvesTo: GitHub Actions run <runId> of the routed repository
@external/github-actions.purpose: CI evidence of a build or rollout, read only.

@external/minio.resolvesTo: MinIO object contents/<contentId>/<locale>.json through the routed runtime
@external/minio.purpose: Authored lesson content as served, not as drafted.

segments.note: Human-friendly segments inside any checkout alias (@workspaces/fe, @workspaces/be, @workspaces/<project>/<role>), mapped to the exact path. Write the friendly word; the resolver substitutes the path.
segments.gates: package.json#scripts plus the configs it names (eslint.config.*, tsconfig*.json, jest.config.*/vitest.config.*, sonar-project.properties)
